high_level_description: The image is a bar chart titled "Number of Women Employed in Factories." It displays the direct employment of women across various Indian states, based on data from the Annual Survey of Industries for the years 2022-2023. The chart is created with Datawrapper by Nilakantan RS. Title: The title is prominently displayed at the top of the chart: "Number of Women Employed in Factories." Subtitle: Below the title, there is a subtitle that reads: "Direct Employment across All Factories."
